entities.summary: William of Heytesbury, or William Heytesbury, or William de Heytisbury, called in Latin  Guglielmus Hentisberus or Tisberus, was an English philosopher and logician, best known as one of the Oxford Calculators of Merton College, Oxford, where he was a fellow.
